claims.statement: The South Fulham Clean Air Neighbourhood has reduced overall traffic by 23 per cent.
claims.sourceQuote: Councillor Roseanne Meacher, Deputy Cabinet Member for Upstream London, highlighted the success of the South Fulham Clean Air Neighbourhood, which has reportedly reduced overall traffic by 23 per cent
claims.sourceDocument: Full Council Hammersmith and Fulham, 21 October 2026

claims.statement: Free access will remain for all borough residents, visitors, carers, and black cabs.
claims.sourceQuote: These new neighbourhood improvement schemes will remain inclusive, with free access for all Hammersmith and Fulham residents and their visitors. Automatic exemptions will be in place for carers, emergency services, black cabs, ride-hailing taxis, and essential deliveries.
claims.sourceDocument: Full Council Hammersmith and Fulham, 21 October 2026

takeawayCard.title: Free access stays fully protected
takeawayCard.subtitle: Exemptions cover carers, cabs, and local deliveries.

keyPoints: Clean air schemes cut local traffic by twenty-three per cent across neighbourhoods.
Previous neighbourhood trials removed fifteen thousand daily vehicles from residential streets.
Free access remains for residents, visitors, black cabs, and essential deliveries.
